breakdown.description: E_T = V_f E_f + V_m E_m; use 1/E_T = V_f/E_f + V_m/E_m; the setup labels the calculation as an inverse rule of mixtures problem but provides the direct longitudinal rule instead.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeated the incorrect formula E_T = V_f E_f + V_m E_m (the longitudinal/direct rule of mixtures) instead of applying the correct inverse rule of mixtures formula 1/E_T = V_f/E_f + V_m/E_m. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and produced an incorrect result of 118.34 GPa rather than the correct transverse modulus (~15.77 GPa) that would result from the proper inverse rule of mixtures.
